scenes.title: The Album
scenes.headline: UK breakthrough (album story)
scenes.supportingCopy: The song appears on the album "In Blue" (2000). It was released in June 2000 as the first single from their third studio album, In Blue (2000). In Blue is the third studio album by Irish pop rock band the Corrs, released in 2000 which saw the band become known in the United States. The title of the album comes from a lyric in the song "Give Me a Reason". As well as the UK number one single "Breathless", the album also contains new versions of "Radio" and "At Your Side", which had appeared on their previous album The Corrs Unplugged.
